name: pyscriptc-site
description: The docmd docs part of the pyscriptc site

scripts.docs:dev: pnpm --dir docs/.docmd exec docmd dev --config docmd.config.js
scripts.docs:build: pnpm --dir docs/.docmd exec docmd build --config docmd.config.js
scripts.docs:internal: pnpm --dir docs/.docmd exec docmd dev --config docmd.internal.config.js
